{{Infobox |eng = Daffodil |source = [[Foraging]] • [[Spring Seeds]] • purchase at the [[Flower Dance]] |season = Spring |sellprice = 30 |edibility = 0 |xp = 7 [[Foraging#Experience Points|Foraging XP]] }} The '''Daffodil''' is found via [[foraging]] in the [[Spring]], or grown from [[Spring Seeds]]. Up to ten can also be purchased from [[Pierre]] at the [[Flower Dance]] for {{Price|50}} each. Up to five may be purchased from [[Evelyn]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|15|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s each. It can randomly be found in [[Garbage Can]]s during Spring. The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces one Daffodil per year on [[Sandy]]'s birthday, [[Fall|Fall 15]]. Although it is a flower in its description (and in real life), the game classifies it as "Forage" and not "Flower." ==Healing== The Daffodil is edible, but does not increase [[Energy]] or [[Health]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |neutral=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Abigail,Alex,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Marnie |dislike=Sebastian,Sam,Shane,Elliott,Dwarf,Wizard,Willy,Krobus,Leo |like=Linus,Pierre,Caroline,George,Evelyn,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Kent,Leah,Gus,Harvey |hate=Jodi |love=Sandy }} ==Bundles== Daffodil is used in the {{Bundle|Spring Foraging||y}}. ==Recipes== {|class="wikitable roundedborder" !Image !Name !Description !Ingredients !Recipe Source !Sell Price |- |[[File:Spring Seeds.png|center]] |[[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds (Sp)]] ||{{Description|Spring Seeds}}
''(Produces 10 Spring Seeds per craft.)'' |{{Name|Wild Horseradish|1}}{{Name|Daffodil|1}}{{Name|Leek|1}}{{Name|Dandelion|1}} |class="no-wrap"|[[File:Foraging Skill Icon.png|24px|link=]] [[Foraging#Foraging Skill|Foraging]] Level 1 |{{Price|35}} |- |} ==Tailoring== Daffodil is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[File:Shirt067.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== Daffodil may be randomly requested in [[Spring]] at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|90}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.6|Can now be purchased from [[Evelyn]] at the [[Desert Festival]].}} {{NavboxForaging}} [[Category:Spring Forage]] [[de:Narzisse]] [[es:Narciso]] [[fr:Jonquille]] [[it:Giunchiglia]] [[ja:ラッパスイセン]] [[ko:수선화]] [[hu:Nárcisz]] [[pt:Narciso]] [[ru:Нарцисс]] [[tr:Fulya]] [[zh:黄水仙]]
